versions.content: Include guard All header files (except memory mapping header files) shall protect themselves against multiple inclusions in the following way: start of file #ifndef identifier #define identifier /* content */ #endif end of file The identifer that is used shall be unique across all header files in the project. There may be only comments outside of the #ifndef - #endif bracket.
